description:
Hi! I'm Rawan, a high school student passionate about science, technology, and space exploration.

I enjoy scientific research, learning new skills, and finding creative solutions to real-world problems. I have basic programming knowledge and I'm eager to develop my technical and problem-solving skills.

I'm looking for motivated teammates interested in coding, software development, game design, and space science.

My goal is to build an innovative project, exchange ideas, learn from others
